entries.title: genesis
lines: Born in one transaction. 1,000,000,000 minted. Ten dens
dug — six smell of equities, four smell of memes. Ten
full-range positions sealed into a lock with no doors.
50,000,000 poured into a bowl the creator cannot touch
for 30 days. There was no second transaction.

entries.title: the first muzzle
lines: The 0.5% muzzle comes off — by the launch schedule,
not witnessed. The lock records what it is told here.

entries.title: FEEDING №1 · 10/10 dens
lines: 43,961,113 PACK burned · 658,308 bought back and buried deeper
The first meal. The launch bots pushed 811,000,000 PACK
through the NVDA den in six hours, paying 1% each pass.
Every fee ended in the wolf's teeth. 4.4% of everything,
gone in two minutes. The wolf did not thank them.
Keepers fed: 0x346dc337, 0xd2546e1d — 444,052 in bounties (PACK side).
── milestone: 1%. Then 2%. Then 3%. Then 4% of genesis, smoke. All in one meal. ──

entries.title: dust · week 0
lines: Strangers burned 0.47 PACK of their own this week,
in 2 small gestures. The wolf appreciates the gestures.

entries.title: the second muzzle
lines: The 2% muzzle comes off — by the launch schedule. Uncapped
from here on. The schedule says forever; forever is untested.
